name: MonarchAiCitation
title: AiCitation
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.clickable on a MonarchText marker, MonarchPopover (androidx.compose.ui.window.Popup) for the card, MonarchFavicon, MonarchButton and MonarchLink
summary: A [1] marker after a sentence of an AI answer that opens a card with the cited source's title, its kind and site, the quoted passage and a way to open it.
whenToUse: After a sentence of an AI answer that rests on a source part of the message, so the person can check where it came from without leaving the answer.
whenNotToUse: For the full list of sources under an answer, list the source parts with MonarchLinkCard or MonarchSearchResultItem. For a footnote in ordinary text, write the reference in the text.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiCitation(index: Int, source: MonarchAiSourcePart, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, quote: String? = null, image: Painter? = null, expanded: Boolean? = null, onExpandedChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, onOpen: ((MonarchAiSourcePart) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchAiCitationLabels = MonarchAiCitationLabels(), interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)
object MonarchAiCitationDefaults { fun sourceNumbers(parts: List<MonarchAiPart>): Map<String, Int> }

class MonarchAiCitationLabels(marker: ((index: Int, title: String) -> String)? = null, card: ((index: Int) -> String)? = null, open: String? = null, visit: String? = null, kind: ((MonarchAiSourceKind) -> String)? = null)

options.name: index
options.description: The number shown in the marker; 1 shows [1]. Number a message's sources with MonarchAiCitationDefaults.sourceNumbers.

options.name: source
options.description: The cited source part of the message.

options.name: quote
options.description: The passage the answer relies on, from the citation part. Shown in the card.

options.name: image
options.description: The source's favicon, loaded by the app from source.favicon. null shows a letter tile.

options.name: expanded
options.description: Whether the card is open, to control it from outside. null lets the marker keep its own state.

options.name: onExpandedChange
options.description: Called when the marker, Open source or a dismissal asks to open or close the card.

options.name: onOpen
options.description: Opens the source inside the app. Shows Open source in the card, which closes the card first. Without it the card links to the source's http, https or mailto address.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replaces the marker's spoken name, the card heading, Open source, Visit page and the kind names.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The interaction source of the marker.

states.name: closed
states.description: The marker [n] in the link color in the caption style.

states.name: open
states.description: A MonarchPopover card on the raised background with the heading, the favicon and title, the meta line (kind, site, product), the quote on the subtle background with a strong start bar, and the action.

states.name: open source
states.description: With onOpen, a small secondary MonarchButton Open source that closes the card and calls back.

states.name: visit page
states.description: Without onOpen and with an http, https or mailto address, an external MonarchLink Visit page that opens it with the platform URI handler.

states.name: no action
states.description: Without onOpen and without a safe address the card has no button or link.

appearance: The marker is caption text in the link color. The card is MonarchPopover's raised surface with its border and shadow, the heading in the subheading style, the title in the strong body style, the meta line in the caption style in the muted text color, and the quote on the subtle background with a bar in the strong border color. All colors are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: Same names as iOS, except that iOS's isPresented binding is expanded with onExpandedChange. The web opens the card on hover and focus after a delay and pins it on click; a phone has no hover, so a tap opens and closes it and openDelay and closeDelay are not offered. A Compose Text cannot contain a control, so the marker sits after the sentence in a Row or FlowRow instead of inside the text run. The favicon is a Painter the app loads (Monarch has no image loader); without it a letter tile is shown where iOS shows a kind symbol, because Monarch bundles no icons. Relative addresses, which the web resolves against the page, are not opened.
accessibility: The marker is one element with the button role named "Source <n>: <title>"; the brackets are not read.
The marker has a 48dp touch target, reserved in the layout, although it draws as small text.
The card is a popup that takes focus, named by its heading (pane title), and the back gesture or a tap outside closes it.
The card's heading has the heading semantics; the favicon is decoration and hidden from TalkBack.
Visit page is an external MonarchLink, read with "opens in the browser"; Open source is a MonarchButton with a 48dp target.
edgeCases: A source repeated in a message keeps its first number in sourceNumbers.
A javascript:, file: or relative address is neither opened nor shown as the site.
A leading www. is left out of the site in the meta line.
Long titles and quotes wrap; the card is at most 320dp wide and never wider than the window minus its margins.

examples.title: Inline citations with a preview
Open the source inside the app
examples.code:
MonarchAiCitation(
    index = 2,
    source = MonarchAiSourcePart(id = "plan", title = "Q3 plan", kind = MonarchAiSourceKind.Doc, product = "Dossier"),
    onOpen = { previewing = it.id },
)
